newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ sees full div franking for 96/97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ sees full div franking for 96/97.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected to sustain full franking of its dividends in the current year to September 30, 1997, but there may be a limit on franking in the following years as a higher proportion of profits was generated offshore.
"We expect to sustain full franking at least for the 1997 financial year," ANZ said after releasing its 1995/96 annual results.
"We are particularly pleased that we have been able to move to full franking earlier than had been anticipated," it said.
"However, there may be some limit on franking capacity thereafter, if the proportion of group profits earning offshore continues to increase," it said.
ANZ earlier posted a six percent rise in net profit to A$1.116 billion in the year to September 30.
It also increased the final dividend to 24 cents from 18 cents and said the final dividend would be fully franked.
